# Sample Generation Intervals

Draws n samples from a lognormal distribution representing generation
intervals (time between successive infections).

## Usage

``` r
gi.dist.samp(n, meanlog = 1.376, sdlog = 0.567)
```

## Arguments

- n:

  Integer. Number of samples to draw.

- meanlog:

  Numeric. Mean of the distribution on the log scale. Default is 1.376
  (COVID-19 estimate, ~3.96 day median).

- sdlog:

  Numeric. Standard deviation of the distribution on the log scale.
  Default is 0.567 (COVID-19 estimate).

## Value

Numeric vector of length n containing generation intervals in days.

## Details

The default parameters are calibrated to COVID-19 data. For other
diseases, supply appropriate lognormal parameters:

- Influenza: meanlog ≈ 0.91, sdlog ≈ 0.52 (~2.5 day median)

- SARS: meanlog ≈ 2.0, sdlog ≈ 0.45 (~7.4 day median)

- Measles: meanlog ≈ 2.4, sdlog ≈ 0.3 (~11 day median)

gi.dist.samp(100)
